item.title: ChatGPT stuns veteran investor when asked what a normal person should do to become rich
item.description: In a recent Diary of a CEO episode, Steven Bartlett tested ChatGPT on personal finance with JL Collins. The AI’s advice, invest in low-cost index funds, avoid debt, live below your means, mirrored Collins’ Simple Path to Wealth. The discussion shifted to high-demand skills and AI-driven job displacement, highlighting that while technology reshapes work, timeless wealth-building principles remain unchanged.
item.dc:creator: TOI Trending Desk

item.title: Will Earth lose gravity in 2026? Viral ‘Project Anchor’ claim sparks panic, NASA responds
item.description: NASA has dismissed viral claims that Earth will briefly “lose gravity” in August 2026, calling the theory scientifically impossible. The agency says gravity is determined by Earth’s mass and cannot switch off, and that the upcoming solar eclipse will have no effect on it. Scientists say the rumour reflects basic misunderstandings of physics.
item.dc:creator: TOI Trending Desk

item.title: DJ Akademiks says NBA YoungBoy tried to contact Kai Cenat over cheating rumors
item.description: Rapper NBA YoungBoy is reportedly upset. He tried to contact streamer Kai Cenat. This was to deny rumors linking him to Cenat's ex-girlfriend, Gigi Alayah. Cenat has not responded. This silence allows the speculation to continue. YoungBoy's team believes the rumor was planted. They want a direct conversation to clear his name.

item.title: World’s most-followed TikToker Khaby Lame closes nearly $900M business deal
item.description: Khaby Lame, the world's top TikTok creator, has sold his company for almost $900 million. This deal includes a hyper-realistic AI version of Khaby. This digital twin will create ads without Khaby's physical presence. Brands can now run global campaigns simultaneously. This move marks a new era for influencer marketing and personal brand monetization.

item.title: 'It’s not about India but about his distaste for immigration': Indian American constitutional scholar over H-1B programme
item.description: Constitutional scholar Saikrishna Prakash stated that US immigration restrictions reflect President Trump's general hostility towards immigration, not a specific stance against India. He warned that executive power now overshadows Congress, leaving Indian professionals vulnerable to discretionary policy shifts. Prakash suggested this could lead to a geographic redistribution of Indian talent globally.

item.title: Winter storm alert: 7 things to know as storm disrupts flights and travel across the US
item.description: A massive winter storm is poised to batter over half the US, bringing snow, ice, and extreme cold to more than 160 million. States are declaring emergencies as travel faces severe disruption, with thousands of flights already cancelled. Residents are urged to prepare for potential power outages and dangerously low temperatures following the storm's passage.

item.title: Expats in the UAE: Check if you can exchange your driving licence without a test
item.description: Expatriates in the UAE can now easily exchange their driving licences from 57 countries, including recent additions like Croatia and Texas, bypassing lengthy tests. This streamlined process, requiring a valid licence and an eye test, allows professionals and families to quickly get on the road, reinforcing the UAE's 'move-in ready' status for its diverse international community.

item.title: 'Cosmic poetic justice': Donald Trump's estranged niece says uncle was 'humiliating himself on daily basis'
item.description: Donald Trump's niece, Mary, a clinical psychologist, stated her uncle is humiliating himself daily and losing control, both personally and over the narrative. She cited his recent behavior at the World Economic Forum, including misidentifying countries and rambling speeches, as evidence of his psychological, cognitive, and physical decline, suggesting he is unfit to lead.

item.title: How to buy Emmanuel Macron's sunglasses?
item.description: Say what you want about the French, they always know how to do things with style. Revolutions, republics, beheadings, exiles. Even their authoritarians have style. When Jean-Paul Sartre was arrested, Charles de Gaulle asked him to be released immediately, saying in a rather bathetic style: “One doesn’t arrest Voltaire.”

item.title: Over Rs 1.5 lakh for 90-minute ER visit? Indian man breaks down the cost of US medical care
item.description: An Indian man living in the US shared his experience of being charged $1,800 for a 1.5-hour hospital visit after a knee injury during ice skating. He opted for a taxi over an ambulance due to high costs. The bill, after insurance, highlighted the significant expense of American healthcare, sparking discussions about its affordability and accessibility compared to other countries.
